description: Atlyn Sankey Chart helps Power BI authors explain how volume, spend, units, or value flows from one dimension to another. Use source, target, and weight fields to draw proportional ribbons between categories, subcategories, vendors, products, regions, or process stages. Key features: - Proportional links driven by a weight measure - Node and link coloring, alignment modes, and labels - Rich hover tooltips on nodes and links - Formatting pane control over spacing, colors, and labels; high-contrast and theme aware; keyboard accessible Common uses: procurement and spend analysis, customer journey and conversion flows, budget allocation, supply-chain movement, and energy or material balance. Interactivity: click a node or link to select and cross-filter other visuals, hover for tooltips, and right-click for the standard context menu. The included sample report demonstrates procurement-style flow analysis with weighted links and usage tips. Licensing: This visual is free to download and evaluate from Microsoft AppSource. Continued commercial use requires a paid AtlynCo subscription after a 30-day free trial. See https://www.atlynco.com/pricing for plans and pricing. Microsoft does not manage licensing or billing for this visual; subscriptions are handled independently by AtlynCo.
